body_markdown:
Howdy all,


Now that we’ve migrated to Route 53 (see other thread for that), Ilia is enabling Cloudfront on our website and new software repositories (all but` forum` and old` software.virtualmin.com` ). This might break` www.virtualmin.com` and the new` download.virtualmin.com` websites.


If it breaks, we probably already know about it, and are working on a fix. But, I figured I’d post about it, just in case.


Cheers,
Joe
